service_required.description: Indicates the urgency level and the associated turnaround time for the requested laboratory analysis.

signed_unsigned.description: Defines the signature or authorization status of the official test report document.

srNumber.description: The master registration number assigned to the sample for comprehensive tracking throughout the lab.

stabilityNoteDetails.description: A flag indicating if specific notes regarding the stability of the test sample are present.

state.description: The geographic region or state from which the sample originated or where the client is located.

status.description: The current operational state of the order, indicating if it is active or inactive.

statusOfHold.description: Indicates if the order is currently suspended or released from a hold status.

sub_category.code.description: The unique alphanumeric code identifying a specific sub-classification of the tested items.

sub_category.name.description: The descriptive name of the product sub-category used for laboratory organizational reporting.

sub_category.type.description: Identifies the structural classification type used for grouping the sub-category record.

submission_type.description: Describes the method by which the sample was physically delivered or provided to the laboratory.

supplied_as_customer.description: Indicates whether the sample was provided directly by the customer rather than collected by the lab.

surcharge_value.description: The specific dollar amount added to the base cost for additional laboratory service requirements.

tatCust.description: A flag indicating if a custom Turnaround Time requirement has been specified for this order.

testEndDate.description: The final calendar date upon which the laboratory analysis procedures were completed.

testStartDate.description: The initial calendar date when the laboratory analysis procedures were officially commenced.

test_standard.code.description: The unique reference code for the specific testing protocol or industry standard applied.

test_standard.name.description: The official title or citation of the regulatory standard followed during the testing process.

time_in_days.description: The expected or actual duration required to complete the testing process, measured in days.

total.description: Represents the final monetary sum charged to the client for all testing services provided in the laboratory order.

updateDate.description: Records the exact timestamp when the last modification was made to the laboratory order record.

updatedBy.description: Stores the unique email address of the system user who performed the most recent edit to the order.

updatedByName.description: Contains the full display name of the staff member responsible for the latest update to the laboratory record.

verificationDate.description: Indicates the specific point in time when the laboratory test results were officially reviewed and validated for accuracy.
